_comment: C8S3 monomer in methanol: absorption (Doria et al. 2022, measured) + PL digitized from Fig. 1c of Kuevda et al. JACS 2025 (CC BY 4.0). Same dye and solvent; absorption maxima agree (520 nm). Mode frequency is fitted (single mode: chi2 1.9; two modes: 1.8 with strongly correlated parameters — not used).
